description:
FILED s518d (Opus 5.5, 2026-10-17) from #3284 (Capture-Tiny t/07-stderr-closed.t: ran 1 of no plan, "A nested error within --disable-debugger error handling" -- the program dies while STDERR is closed, so its own message cannot print).  Not minimized.

s518d fixed the first cause (#3371: `defined fileno STDERR` read true on a closed STDERR, so Capture::Tiny never proxied it).  The next stop, seen with scratch/s518d/pr/ct7.pl (Capture::Tiny capture with STDERR closed, inside an eval): `$@` = "Error from close(GLOB(0x1)): Bad file descriptor" -- a `_close` of a glob (GLOB(0x1) is \*STDERR or \*STDOUT, the `$proxies{...}` of _unproxy, lib/Capture/Tiny.pm:172, or the `_close` of `$stash->{old}` at :392) answers false EBADF where perl's succeeds.  perl: `o=[out] e=[err] err=[]`.  Next step: instrument Capture::Tiny's _close to name which handle and its fileno, then probe that close sequence alone vs perl.


=== DONE (s518d resume #2, Opus 5.5, 2026-10-17) ===
Found again from the s518d BOARD diff: Capture-Tiny t/08-stdin-closed.t fell 744/128 -> 1/0 rows once #3371 made `fileno` of a closed standard handle undef -- Capture::Tiny then PROXIES the closed handle, and that path reached TWO pre-existing runtime bugs (both on ff4c1500 too; the old fileno answer hid them):
(a) `%p-make-hash-entry` (the hash construction arm: `%h = (...)`, `{...}`) wrapped a glob REF whole -- slot box -> ref box -> glob, one level deeper than every slot reader and than the array arm (#423) -- so `%h = (k => \*STDIN); sub f { close $_[0] } f($h{k})` answered EBADF (perl: ok).  Minimal: scratch/s518d/pr/c08j.pl.  Fix: ONE copy rule `%p-glob-container-copy` shared by both construction arms.
(b) `%p-rebind-std`: a standard handle reopened ONTO its own descriptor (STDIN closed, so `open STDIN, "<", "/dev/null"` gets fd 0) dropped the opened CL stream with its auto-close finalizer still armed; a later GC's finalizer thread closed fd 0 under whatever held it by then (strace -f: thread 2's close(0) right after a File::Temp openat got fd 0 -> raw `fstat: Bad file descriptor` backtrace, nondeterministic: 126-287 rows per run).  Fix: `sb-ext:cancel-finalization` on that stream (the dup2 branch still closes it).
Both rows inverse-verified on a HEAD extraction: Pl/t/tiehandle-01.t 24 -> 26.  08-stdin-closed.t AND 07-stderr-closed.t (this task's own file) 744 / 128 in three runs each = the blessed count.  Commit efdaf775 (s518d).
subject: Capture-Tiny 07-stderr-closed.t: with STDERR closed, a Capture::Tiny _close of a standard glob answers EBADF (perl succeeds) -- the next stop after #3371
